title: One clean slice before the course
statement: Build and fully review one complete, representative slice of lessons, by hand if need be, before automating or making the rest, and make it the template.
example: The plan allowed 48 hours for one audit-clean slice of 6-7 lessons.
detail: The reading project's delivery plan for a Grade 5 course committed to 48 hours for one audit-clean vertical slice of 6-7 lessons before the rest of the course (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/HOTBUCKET.md`, the 2026-07-15 delivery-control entry). Its control rule replaces every earlier estimate at that gate, and a missed gate changes the date, never the quality bar (the same entry). The slice goes through every check before the rest is made.
against: This is a plan's commitment; nothing cited here records the slice gate being met or missed. in an AP generator project the bar moved instead: set on 2026-04-26, softened between 04-27 and 04-28, and repinned on 2026-06-08 (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0063-aptraining-prior-exploration.qmd`). A later run found counter-evidence (`grade3-reading/artifacts/judgment-corpus/distilled-src/09-PIPELINE-OPS.md`).
